text: Applied and opened a business checking account on XX/XX/XXXX with a welcome offer that was in my " Rewards & Deals '' login page. Applied via that link. I met all requirements for the bonus. XX/XX/XXXX : Chatted via phone app, rep said no offer attached, and when I gave them the offer code ( which was pre-filled in the application link ), they said it had expired in XX/XX/XXXX. Told them that made no sense because all I did was applied via the link on my account. It was clear to me it was an XXXX issue. She submitted inquiry to customer incentive team. XX/XX/XXXX : Phone call to follow up. Said the previous inquiry was denied because the offer code provided had expired. This rep said she found the " correct '' offer and submitted new inquiry with offer details ( no offer code ) XX/XX/XXXX : Phone with rep to follow up. Said the inquiry submitted on XX/XX/XXXX was denied with no reason provided. So she submitted another escalation. Told me to call again in 7-10 XXXX days.
